system.description: If you know the truth but want to obscure it, this is the Skill for you. When you lie and try to get away with it, make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. If the creature you're lying to has the Detect Lies Skill, you make this Check with Disadvantage. On Success, they believe you!

upgrades.description: You can use this Skill while gambling.
You can use this Skill to forge documents.
You're good enough to know when you've been caught. If you fail this Check, you may perform one Action before your foes can react.
